# SIR: многокритериальная оптимизация
Ищем Парето-фронт по (пик, смертность).

```{julia}
import Pkg
Pkg.activate("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab04/project")
using DrWatson

using BlackBoxOptim, Random, Statistics
using JLD2

ENV["GKSwstype"] = "100"

include("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab04/project/src/sir_model.jl")

script_name = "sir_optimize_parameters"
mkpath(plotsdir(script_name))
mkpath(datadir(script_name))

function cost_multi(x)
    β_val = x[1]
    detection_time_val = round(Int, x[2])
    death_rate_val = x[3]

    replicates = 5
    peak_vals = Float64[]
    dead_vals = Int[]

    for rep in 1:replicates
        model = initialize_sir(;
            Ns = [1000, 1000, 1000],
            β_und = fill(β_val, 3),
            β_det = fill(β_val/10, 3),
            infection_period = 14,
            detection_time = detection_time_val,
            death_rate = death_rate_val,
            reinfection_probability = 0.1,
            Is = [0, 0, 1],
            seed = 42 + rep,
            n_steps = 100)

        infected_frac(model) = count(a.status == :I for a in allagents(model)) / nagents(model)
        peak_infected = 0.0
        for step in 1:100
            Agents.step!(model, 1)
            frac = infected_frac(model)
            frac > peak_infected && (peak_infected = frac)
        end
        push!(peak_vals, peak_infected)
        push!(dead_vals, 3000 - nagents(model))
    end

    return (mean(peak_vals), mean(dead_vals) / 3000)
end

result = bboptimize(
    cost_multi;
    Method = :borg_moea,
    FitnessScheme = BlackBoxOptim.ParetoFitnessScheme{2}(is_minimizing=true),
    SearchRange = [
        (0.1, 1.0),
        (3.0, 14.0),
        (0.01, 0.1)
    ],
    NumDimensions = 3,
    MaxTime = 60,
    TraceMode = :compact
)

best = best_candidate(result)
fitness = best_fitness(result)

println("Оптимальные параметры:")
println("β_und = ", best[1])
println("detection_time = ", round(Int, best[2]), " дней")
println("death_rate = ", best[3])
println("Пик = ", fitness[1])
println("Доля умерших = ", fitness[2])

@save datadir(script_name, "optimization_result.jld2") best fitness
```
